clean_source_blocks.text: Now one of the biggest sportswear firms, Anta's rise follows a playbook adopted by many Chinese giants.

For instance, Anta Sports, a leading sportswear firm, is sponsoring Chinese players' podium uniforms and several Chinese national teams taking part in swimming, artistic swimming and gymnastics, among others.

Not to lag behind, second-tier Chinese sportswear brands are sponsoring other countries' national teams or niche sports like bicycle motocross. Peak Sports, a well-known Chinese sports equipment maker, is sponsoring as many as 11 n...
Li Ning, another prominent Chinese sportswear brand, sponsored some of the most decorated Chinese national teams taking part in table tennis, diving and shooting.

source_text:
Now one of the biggest sportswear firms, Anta's rise follows a playbook adopted by many Chinese giants.

For instance, Anta Sports, a leading sportswear firm, is sponsoring Chinese players' podium uniforms and several Chinese national teams taking part in swimming, artistic swimming and gymnastics, among others.

Not to lag behind, second-tier Chinese sportswear brands are sponsoring other countries' national teams or niche sports like bicycle motocross. Peak Sports, a well-known Chinese sports equipment maker, is sponsoring as many as 11 n...

Li Ning, another prominent Chinese sportswear brand, sponsored some of the most decorated Chinese national teams taking part in table tennis, diving and shooting.
